sources_checked: arXiv official cs.RO pastweek list (156 entries)
arXiv HTML full text (13 priority candidates)
run.note: First full-text batch from the 2026-08-11 to 2026-08-12 discovery window. Scores are editorial triage, not permanent rankings.

candidates.title: XPolicyLab: A Unified Standard and Open Ecosystem for Robot Policy Evaluation and Deployment

embodied_relevance.evidence: Standardizes trained robot-policy serving, evaluation and deployment across simulation and physical platforms.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv full text, project page and repository were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Defines a shared policy contract and adapters instead of another model-specific evaluation wrapper.

claim_support.evidence: Evaluates 50 RoboTwin tasks, 42 RoboDojo tasks and 18 physical tasks across three bimanual embodiments; includes integration-effort measurements.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Architecture, integrations, simulation evaluation, 180 physical trials and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: XPolicyLab把不同VLA、WAM和模仿学习策略的依赖、输入输出、服务和评测收敛到统一契约，并贯通RoboTwin、RoboDojo与真机。代表性策略接入从5小时以上降到2小时，配合agent skill降到约30分钟；公共基础设施价值高于又一个单模型榜单。
risks_or_uncertainties: 社区维护和版本兼容成本将决定长期价值
真机绝对成功率仍低，仿真排名与现实只部分一致

candidates.title: WorldSimProbe: Diagnosing Simulator Faithfulness in Action-Conditioned World Models for Embodied Manipulation
organizations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

embodied_relevance.evidence: Tests whether action-conditioned world models satisfy the observable behavior expected of robot simulators.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text, project, code and data were read and verified.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Introduces an Observable Simulator Contract and five diagnostic suites focused on action realization and grounded interaction rather than visual plausibility.

claim_support.evidence: Six open ACWMs, RoboTwin/ManiSkill/LIBERO, controlled perturbations, eight interaction primitives, human judgments and downstream policy comparisons.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Benchmark design, experiments, validation, release plan and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: WorldSimProbe不再只看生成视频是否逼真，而是检查动作是否真的驱动机器人、环境响应是否由该动作接地。六个开源ACWM、三套平台和八类交互原语给出了细粒度故障诊断；与刚收集的GAUGE方向相近，因此信息增益被主动下调。
risks_or_uncertainties: 当前仍以仿真参考为主，没有真实物理测量
长时序闭环、多物体和可变形交互尚未覆盖

candidates.title: Flex-pi: A Multi-Stream World-Action Model with Compute Flexibility

embodied_relevance.evidence: Multi-stream WAM is evaluated on simulation and precise real-world bimanual manipulation.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text, project page and repository were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: One checkpoint jointly learns RGB, pointmap geometry and DINO semantics and can vary observed/predicted streams at deployment without retraining.

claim_support.evidence: Broad simulation, OOD, real-robot, depth-input, stream-dropout, latency and memory evaluations support the compute-flexibility claim.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, benchmarks, real-world protocol, systems analysis and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: Flex-pi把RGB、3D pointmap与DINO语义放进同一预训练潜空间，并允许同一checkpoint在部署时切换输入/预测流，在速度—精度曲线上选择运行点。其价值不只是增加监督模态，而是把算力弹性做成同一策略的部署属性。
risks_or_uncertainties: 模型仍为6B规模，低算力端的绝对成本不低
跨机器人与跨传感器泛化仍需更广验证

candidates.title: SLIM-0.5B: Learning Action-Grounded Predictive Latents for Robot Manipulation

embodied_relevance.evidence: Compact latent interaction policy is evaluated on robot-manipulation simulation and five real tasks with visual perturbations.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text, project and repository were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Uses masked trajectory prediction to jointly reconstruct actions and future latents in a 0.5B Mixture-of-Transformers policy.

claim_support.evidence: LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, CALVIN and real-world experiments plus controlled latency, VRAM, FLOPs and collapse ablations.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Training recipe, benchmarks, real evaluation, efficiency analysis and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: SLIM用0.5B参数和action-grounded predictive latent取得接近或超过更大VLA/WAM的结果，同时报告统一H100设置下的延迟、显存和FLOPs。它对“小模型是否能保留动力学结构”给出了较完整的能力—效率证据。
risks_or_uncertainties: 只验证单一模型规模，尚不能推出缩放规律
跨embodiment数据与更复杂任务覆盖有限

candidates.title: VIScore: Diagnosing Planning-Relevant Quality in Latent World Models

asset_checks.note: Page returns 200 but model API returned 404; do not count as a separately verified model artifact.

embodied_relevance.evidence: Diagnoses latent world models specifically for action planning success on embodied control tasks.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text, project, code and data were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: VIScore jointly measures encoder veracity, predictor influence and planner sobriety rather than latent geometry alone.

claim_support.evidence: Held-out checkpoints, methods, datasets and planners; correlation and calibration tests plus factor ablations support the diagnostic claim.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Metric derivation, evaluations, transfer tests, counter-cases and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: VIScore把世界模型规划质量拆成veracity、influence和sobriety，覆盖编码器、预测器、规划器及任务容差；在未见checkpoint和方法上比只看潜空间的指标更能解释成功率。它具身相关性略低于直接策略论文，但诊断价值与开放资产很强。
risks_or_uncertainties: 主要任务族仍较窄，跨任务校准依赖规划器本身能力可比
模型页API状态存在歧义，暂不把它单独计为已验证权重

candidates.title: JEPA-WAM: Learning Vision-Language-Action Policies with Joint-Embedding World Modeling

embodied_relevance.evidence: Latent WAM directly trains VLA manipulation policies and includes real bimanual experiments.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text, project and repository were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Predicts a joint current-future V-JEPA target with dense correspondence and shares the transition predictor with action generation.

claim_support.evidence: LIBERO-Plus, RoboTwin 2.0, real bimanual tasks, representation probes, bootstrap intervals, latency and ablations.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, benchmarks, probes, real evaluation and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: 该JEPA-WAM用联合编码的当前—未来target学习稠密transition representation，并让预测监督直接塑造动作backbone；LIBERO-Plus无大规模机器人预训练版本达到79.2%，pi0.5版本86.3%，另有RoboTwin与真机验证。
risks_or_uncertainties: 与8月12日另一篇同名JEPA-WAM完全不同，发布时必须以arXiv ID区分
团队机构仍待人工从PDF affiliation复核

candidates.title: Vid2WAM: Distilling Video Diffusion Priors into World Action Models
organizations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

embodied_relevance.evidence: Distills video diffusion futures and inverse-dynamics pseudo-actions into robot WAM policies.

primary_source.evidence: Official full text, project and repository were read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Separates visual-future and pseudo-action distillation channels and uses source-aware residual adaptation to control noisy synthetic supervision.

claim_support.evidence: RoboTwin low-data/withheld-task regimes, OOD settings, real-world evaluation, source and objective ablations, and latency analysis.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, simulation, real experiments, ablations and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: Vid2WAM用视频扩散模型生成未来视觉监督，再用inverse dynamics恢复伪动作，把昂贵专家示范之外的视频先验蒸馏进轻量WAM；在低数据和留出新任务上稳定优于Fast-WAM，并保留低延迟部署。
risks_or_uncertainties: 结果依赖视频teacher与inverse-dynamics伪标签质量
开源仓库虽可访问，仍需人工确认训练权重和完整配置

candidates.title: 4D-WAM: Infusing Spatiotemporal Awareness into World Action Models through Trajectory Fields

embodied_relevance.evidence: Injects dynamic 3D trajectory structure into manipulation WAM training and evaluates real-world policies.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv full text was read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Motion and destination alignment transfer 3D trajectory-field supervision into WAM features without inference-time modules.

claim_support.evidence: Multiple WAM backbones, ID/OOD benchmarks, real tasks, video-structure metrics, ablations and training-cost analysis.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, simulations, real experiments, ablations, compute and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: 4D-WAM用trajectory field的局部运动与终点关系监督WAM，使动态3D结构进入训练，同时缓存特征后几乎不增加训练成本，推理阶段零额外模块。跨backbone、OOD和真机结果比单一排行榜更有说服力。
risks_or_uncertainties: 未找到官方代码或项目页
依赖预提取trajectory field，生成监督的误差可能传递到策略
机构信息待PDF复核

candidates.title: JEPA-WAM: Stage-Level Joint-Embedding Prediction for World-Action Models in Robot Manipulation

embodied_relevance.evidence: Adds stage-level task progress prediction to a manipulation WAM and evaluates simulation plus a dual-arm robot.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Separates short physical futures from semantic next-stage targets and injects the latter through a learned gate.

claim_support.evidence: 50 RoboTwin tasks, 10,000 episodes per checkpoint, component ablations, execution-length analysis and two real tasks.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, full benchmark, ablations, real evaluation and future-work limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: 这篇同名JEPA-WAM预测下一任务阶段的语义latent，再指导Motus的短时视频—动作生成；RoboTwin 50任务总体成功率90.25%，成功轨迹步骤减少5.97%。概念清楚，但真机仅两项任务、无代码，且与另一篇同名工作容易混淆。
risks_or_uncertainties: 与arxiv-2608.09381同名但不是同一工作，必须独立建ID
真机覆盖只有两个任务
代码与机构信息待确认

candidates.title: AdaDexGrasp: Adaptive Dexterous Grasping via 3D Visuo-Tactile Representation Fusion
organizations: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

embodied_relevance.evidence: Directly addresses tactile-guided dexterous grasp generation, feasibility prediction and post-contact refinement.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv full text was read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Associates tactile contacts with finger identity in a 3D representation used before and after contact.

claim_support.evidence: Simulation and real-world grasping, unseen objects/categories, component ablations and contact-stability analysis.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, evaluation protocol, ablations, physical analysis and conclusion were read.

candidates.selection_reason: AdaDexGrasp把按手指身份编码的触觉接触与物体几何统一起来，既参与初始抓取生成，也在接触后迭代修正。未见类别和真机结果支持自适应抓取主张，但开源资产缺失、真实实验规模仍需人工重点审核。
risks_or_uncertainties: 未找到官方代码、数据或项目页
多模块流水线的误差与运行频率需要进一步复核

candidates.title: GWM-VLA: Geometry-Aware Latent World Modeling for Vision-Language-Action Learning

embodied_relevance.evidence: Geometry-aware multi-view latent world modeling directly trains VLA manipulation policies.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv full text was read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Jointly aggregates synchronous camera geometry and predicts a target view while sharing latent-action representations with control.

claim_support.evidence: LIBERO, seven-shift LIBERO-Plus, SO-101 real tasks and targeted ablations support robustness claims.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, simulation, real experiments, ablations and explicit limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: GWM-VLA用VGGT式同步多视角聚合建立几何latent state，并让预测与动作共享latent-action表示；LIBERO-Plus与SO-101小样本实验支持视觉变化鲁棒性。它接近featured，但没有资产且依赖同步多视角，信息增益低于同批Flex-pi与4D-WAM。
risks_or_uncertainties: 依赖同一时刻多视角，难用于大规模单目人类视频
训练使用固定预测视角
机构和代码待确认

candidates.title: LUCID: Latent-Skill Unified Control via Imagined Dynamics for Long-Horizon Humanoid Loco-Manipulation

embodied_relevance.evidence: Hierarchical model-based RL for long-horizon humanoid loco-manipulation.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv full text was read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Learns macro-dynamics over reusable latent whole-body skills and optimizes the high-level controller through imagined skill transitions.

claim_support.evidence: Multi-object rearrangement, held-out layouts, longer chains, favorable-reset baselines and component ablations provide bounded evidence.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: Method, protocol, results, ablations and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: LUCID在可复用全身技能上学习macro-dynamics，并通过想象rollout训练高层策略，避免脚本式skill handoff。长链和OOD仿真结果有说服力，但当前使用privileged state、仅单一仿真人形且没有真机迁移，因此不进入featured。
risks_or_uncertainties: 依赖privileged state
任务、物体和embodiment多样性有限
没有真实机器人验证和公开资产

candidates.title: RoboSeg: Online Part-Level Semantic Reconstruction for Robotic Manipulation via a Single Eye-in-Hand Camera

embodied_relevance.evidence: Builds an online functional-part map from an eye-in-hand camera and uses it to select real robot grasps.

primary_source.evidence: Official arXiv full text was read.

incremental_contribution.evidence: Combines VLM functional-part prompts, asynchronous RGB-D TSDF fusion, temporal semantic voting and task-conditioned AnyGrasp filtering without CAD scans.

claim_support.evidence: 83.4% mIoU and a 24-trial physical pilot support feasibility, but not broad robustness.

fulltext_for_recommendation.evidence: System, mapping metrics, proposal analysis, physical pilot and limitations were read.

candidates.selection_reason: RoboSeg把在线单目手眼扫描转成可按功能部件检索的3D语义图，再约束AnyGrasp。24次真机中部件选择24/24、综合成功21/24，但对象、姿态和试验数都很小，作者也明确将其定位为feasibility evidence。
risks_or_uncertainties: 仅24次真机、四个物体且人工复位
初始视角标准化，遮挡与姿态变化覆盖不足
未提供代码和组件级运行时间

candidates.title: Learning Physical Interaction: A Survey of Tactile- and Force-aware Robot Learning

embodied_relevance.evidence: Direct survey of tactile- and force-aware robot learning.

claim_support.evidence: The current experimental-paper rubric does not fairly score surveys without author experiments.

candidates.selection_reason: 主题高度相关，但现行量表仍不适合综述；为与此前批次一致，等待综述专用量表，而不是用实验强度项人为压低或抬高。
risks_or_uncertainties: 需要综述专用的覆盖度、检索方法、分类质量和更新机制量表
